prose: OpenAI announced a Codex upgrade at DevDay centered on reusable cloud development environments: instead of each cloud task being an isolated sandbox, environments are now persistent and configurable, accessible from any device - laptop, phone, or cloud. The update also brings a refreshed Codex CLI, a new code review experience, infrastructure-hardening tools, and API enhancements. The direction is clear: Codex as a software-engineering agent that runs wherever the developer happens to be, with continuity between sessions.
highlights: Codex gets reusable cloud development environments, persistent across sessions
Accessible from any device - computer, phone, or cloud
Also announced: refreshed Codex CLI, new code review experience, infra-hardening tools, API updates
Moves Codex from isolated remote sandboxes to persistent, configurable environments
